reading.title: A new workplace
reading.content: The company moved to a modern office in the city centre last month. Each department has an open floor and a small meeting room. Our managers meet with the team every Monday to discuss priorities for the week. Although the economy is uncertain, the leadership has promised no layoffs this quarter.
reading.translationUz: Kompaniya o‘tgan oyda shahar markazidagi zamonaviy ofisga ko‘chdi. Har bir bo‘limda ochiq qavat va kichik yig‘ilishlar xonasi bor. Rahbarlarimiz har dushanba kuni jamoa bilan uchrashib, hafta ustuvorliklarini muhokama qiladi. Iqtisodiyot noaniq bo‘lsa-da, rahbariyat bu chorakda ishdan bo‘shatish bo‘lmasligini va’da qildi.

reading.title: The job interview
reading.content: I had an interview this morning for a role in the marketing department. The hiring manager asked about my previous experience, my strengths, and why I wanted to join the company. I spoke calmly and gave specific examples from my past projects. At the end, she said they would contact me within two weeks with a decision.
reading.translationUz: Bugun ertalab marketing bo‘limidagi lavozim uchun suhbatim bo‘ldi. Yollovchi menejer avvalgi tajribam, kuchli tomonlarim va nega kompaniyaga qo‘shilmoqchi ekanligim haqida so‘radi. Men sokin gapirdim va o‘tmishdagi loyihalarimdan aniq misollar keltirdim. Oxirida u ikki hafta ichida qaror bilan bog‘lanishini aytdi.

reading.title: Remote work culture
reading.content: Since the pandemic many companies have embraced remote work. Employees save hours of commuting and often report higher productivity. However, managers worry about team cohesion and informal knowledge sharing. Some firms now require two office days a week as a compromise between flexibility and collaboration.
reading.translationUz: Pandemiyadan beri ko‘plab kompaniyalar uzoqdan ishlashga o‘tdi. Xodimlar yo‘lga sarflanadigan soatlarni tejashadi va ko‘pincha yuqori samaradorlikni qayd etishadi. Biroq menejerlar jamoa yaxlitligi va norasmiy bilim almashish haqida xavotirda. Ba'zi firmalar endi haftada 2 kun ofisga kelishni talab qiladi — moslashuvchanlik va hamkorlik o‘rtasida murosa sifatida.

reading.title: A balanced budget
reading.content: Our household follows a simple rule: fifty percent for needs, thirty for wants, and twenty for savings. We review the budget on the first weekend of every month and move money between categories if a bill was higher than expected. The system is not perfect, but it keeps us from overspending.
reading.translationUz: Oilamiz oddiy qoidaga amal qiladi: 50% ehtiyojlar uchun, 30% xohishlar uchun va 20% jamg‘arma uchun. Har oyning birinchi dam olish kunida byudjetni ko‘rib chiqamiz va biror hisob kutilganidan baland bo‘lsa, pulni toifalar o‘rtasida ko‘chiramiz. Tizim mukammal emas, lekin ortiqcha xarajat qilishdan saqlaydi.

reading.title: Choosing a career path
reading.content: After graduation I was torn between two offers: a well-paid role at a large bank and a lower salary at a small startup. I chose the startup because of the chance to learn broad skills and work directly with the founders. Two years later I do not regret the decision, even though some weeks have been very demanding.
reading.translationUz: Bitirgandan so‘ng ikki taklif o‘rtasida qoldim: katta bankda yaxshi maosh va startapda past maosh. Men startapni tanladim — chunki keng ko‘nikmalarni o‘rganish va bevosita asoschilar bilan ishlash imkoniyati bor edi. Ikki yildan so‘ng qarorimdan afsuslanmayman, ba'zi haftalar juda og‘ir bo‘lgan bo‘lsa-da.
